killReason: Business case scored 14 of 35 (bar 24; willingnessToPay 2 and distribution 2, both need 3). Free tools close the gap: Lash Map Lab is a free web lash map generator with no sign up, LashMap Studio is free up to 20 clients, and Lash Dash keeps per client maps for USD 3.99 a month. The 33,100 lash map volume was RankHero Etsy data, not Google; tech intent Google searches are small (about 1,550 a month in the US) and tool terms have no measurable volume. No payment rail.

lead.name: Ira
lead.trait: Founder energy. Talks to the problem before the solution.

title: Lash Mapper
oneLiner: Build a lash extension map on your phone by tapping each zone for length, curl and thickness, saved per client and printable

evidence.claim: On the Etsy search for procreate lash tech map, a Lash Mapping Handbook of practice sheets shows 2.5k reviews and a Lash Map Style Guide sells at $21.23 with 48 reviews.
The same Etsy search shows Procreate lash brushes with digital lash maps at $239.21 with 73 reviews, so lash techs pay real money for mapping tools.
Gap: free lash map help is static guides and printable maps (London Lash free lash maps blog), not a tool that builds and saves a map per client on a phone.
The search lash map template returns mostly thin parasite template pages on unrelated university and government domains, not a strong free web tool, which suggests a real tool page could rank.
Lash techs ask for exactly this: a post in a lash tech Facebook group asks how other techs keep track of each client lash mapping so they know which map to use at fills.
In the same lash tech Facebook group another tech asks whether there is an app for digital lash mapping and what people use to put the lashes on the eyes.

The Lash Look, an App Store lash mapping app with saved client records, charges Premium Lash Tech $39.99 a month or $239.99 a year and Lifetime Access $499.99 (CA store, 8 ratings, 4.3), so a paid tier exists for this job.

Lash Create, a lash mapping and booking app, sells a one-time Premium Unlock at $9.99 and $69.99 plus Individual Artist $19.99 a month on the US App Store, matching our one-time unlock model; it shows too few ratings to display.
Lost Artistry Lash sells Digital Lash Maps, Brushes and Stamps for Procreate at $70.00 CAD, another paid mapping tool for techs.
RankHero keyword data shows lash map at 33,100 monthly searches globally, 67 percent from the United States, CPC $0.74, with lash mapping as a supporting term.

nextAction: None. Killed at the business case.
